description: Source code for a cpio archive handling library, including functions for checking version, listing, extracting, and adding files to cpio archives, with parsing and command execution logic.

methods.name: relative_path
methods.description: Removes leading slash from filename if present.

methods.name: xa_cpio_check_version
methods.description: Checks if the cpio version is at least 2.13.

methods.name: xa_cpio_ask
methods.description: Sets capabilities flags for cpio archive operations.

methods.name: xa_cpio_parse_output
methods.description: Parses a line of cpio listing output to extract file info.

methods.name: xa_cpio_list
methods.description: Lists contents of a cpio archive.

methods.name: xa_cpio_extract
methods.description: Extracts files from a cpio archive.

methods.name: xa_cpio_add
methods.description: Adds files to a cpio archive.
